name: Sleeper Agent (HTML)
description: A five-fader mixer for sleeping sound: brown noise, green noise, rain, soft rain and ocean, in any combination rather than one at a time. A space slider runs from mono through plain stereo to a binaural render, so over headphones the noise fills the room instead of sitting on the phone. Sleep timer, fades, tone, swell and a blackout screen underneath; five slow ambient themes on a fader of their own. Generated privately in the browser.
note: Designed for overnight use on a phone. The ambient themes are optional and off by default.
